points.statement: Visual information is interpreted and integrated with agent state and task instruction into a language-model component.
points.quote: Vision perception involves interpreting visual information in the environment, which is then integrated into the LLMs component with agent state and task instruction.

points.statement: A language-instruction part iteratively reasons and decomposes complex tasks into manageable guidelines.
points.quote: Language instruction is responsible for iterative reasoning and decomposing complex tasks into manageable guidelines.

points.statement: Executable skill actions are generated through retrieval from a skill repository.
points.quote: Code action generates executable skill actions based on retrieval in skill database

points.statement: Textual communication struggles to convey certain world concepts, whereas vision communicates them more effectively.
points.quote: textual communication has its limitations in naturally conveying certain concepts of the world, like crafting recipes, which are often more effectively communicated through vision.

points.statement: Combining vision and text inputs provides nuanced understanding of the environment and practical executable skills.
points.quote: combining these two input modes, vision, and text, to offer a more nuanced and comprehensive understanding of the environment and practical and executable skills.
